cases.name: Jennifer Leigh Greimann
cases.about:
She was a nurse practitioner at UnityPoint Health - Des Moines Center for Liver Disease. She worked for the organization for 17 years.

"We are deeply saddened to learn of the loss of our colleague and friend, Jennifer Greimann," UnityPoint said in a statement. "She began her career as a medical/surgical nurse working on an inpatient unit at Iowa Methodist Medical Center.

"For the last four years, she worked in our Center for Liver Disease as an advanced registered nurse practitioner. She was an amazing health care provider as she cared deeply for her patients. We will miss her smile, humor and friendship. Our thoughts and prayers are with her family during this incredibly difficult time."

Her obituary said, "Jennifer Leigh Greimann was the youngest daughter of Larry Lee Thompson and Nancy Jean Biondi-Thompson. She was born on February 4, 1983, in Des Moines. Jennifer completed the family of two older brothers and two older sisters. In her younger years, Jennifer enjoyed dancing and playing drums and piano. Jennifer graduated from Perry High School in 2001. She began her studies at Mount Mercy College, in Cedar Rapids, and continued her education at Grand View University, in Des Moines. In 2005, she graduated with a bachelor’s degree in Nursing. Jennifer married her high school sweetheart, Adam Greimann, on December 3, 2006, in Bouton. Together, they created three wonderful children: Leigha, Avery, and Grant. Jennifer and Adam later divorced but remained the greatest of friends. Jennifer was a determined person and a very compassionate nurse. In 2015, she continued her education at Briar Cliff University, in Sioux City. Over the next three years, Jennifer juggled raising her children, working full-time at Iowa Methodist Medical Center, and succeeding with her post-graduate studies. She graduated with honors from Briar Cliff with a Doctorate in Nursing Practice. Jennifer became an Adult Gerontology Nurse Practitioner and was employed at Unity Point Health – Des Moines Center for Liver Disease. She recently celebrated her 17th year of employment with Unity Point. Jennifer was co-owner of Birdie’s Branch, an aesthetics studio, in Des Moines. Jennifer was a passionate person and loved helping people look and feel their best. Jennifer’s hobbies included shopping, shopping, and more shopping! She had a love for traveling and took her children on many vacations. Together, the four of them made so many memories that they will cherish forever. Jennifer had just finished building the home of her dreams and had a fabulous eye for design and decorating."
